To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
application of metamaterial in microstrip lattice provides suppression of fundamental harmonic of reflected field and alignment of higher harmonics levels in comparison with first one.

the use of metamaterials (MM) as a substrate in microstrip lattices allows to align the levels of the higher harmonic in comparison with the first harmonic in the scattered field, which is achieved through the suppression of the fundamental harmonic in the scattered wave.
the application of metamaterials as substrate of microstrip lattice allows to align the higher harmonics levels in the reflected wave in comparison with fundamental harmonic.

the analysis of nonlinear microstrip lattices with nonlinear loads in strip plane.
a nonlinear metamaterial microstrip lattice with the nonlinear load in the strip plane, which is excited by a harmonic plane wave.
a nonlinear microstrip lattice (NMSL) on the substrate made of metamaterial (MM).

the use of metamaterials for the substrate of microstrip lattices can be considered as an efficient method of nonlinear signal processing.
the use of MM in microstrips as a substrate (as opposed to dielectric) allows to achieve alignment of higher harmonic levels compared to the first one in reflected field.
metamaterials can be effectively used in microstrip lattices to control the level of higher harmonics in the reflected field.
